title: Authorized spec-fidelity correction to the value-path diagnosis classifier
authorized_after_seeing: the H2 seed 23 (and R0 seed 23) reproduced diagnostics, which exposed the divergence

trigger.observation: the A2 linear probe reads the collapsed query-time slot at ~chance (H2 s23 query-decode 0.062), yet the oracle bypasses prove the value is functionally recoverable (A4a=1.0, A4b=1.0) and the oracle correct-slot address fully restores retrieval (A3=1.0).
trigger.problem: the committed classifier gated ADDRESS/READ/RESIDUAL rules on A2 LINEAR decodability, so it would have classified an unambiguous address-distribution failure as VALUE_PATH_NOT_LOCALIZED, contradicting the spec's own interpretation.

spec_basis: §9: a linear-probe failure must NOT be claimed as proof of total information absence
§10: 'oracle address restores retrieval -> evaluation-time address distribution failed'
§11 A4a: the direct query-time read tests whether the ordinary read distribution/aggregation prevents use of a STILL-VALID target-slot value

change.what: operationalize 'query-time slot remains decodable/recoverable' (used by ADDRESS_DISTRIBUTION_FAILED, READ_AGGREGATION_FAILED, RESIDUAL_OR_DECODER_UTILIZATION_FAILED) as query_recoverable = (A4a direct-read recovers) OR (A2 query linearly decodable). Linear decodability is sufficient but not necessary.
unchanged: all frozen thresholds (DECODABLE_MIN, MATERIAL_DROP, RETRIEVAL_PRESENT_MIN, RETRIEVAL_FAILS_MAX, RECOVER_MIN, CONFLICT_COS, CONTROL_GAP) are IDENTICAL
STORAGE_VALUE_DEGRADED keeps the explicit '(linearly) decodable' A2 wording of §14
the A2 linear-decodability profile is still computed and reported as supporting evidence
change.before_rule: if query_linearly_decodable and ordinary_fails and oracle_address_recovers: ADDRESS_DISTRIBUTION_FAILED (and analogously for READ/RESIDUAL)
change.after_rule: if query_recoverable and ordinary_fails and oracle_address_recovers: ADDRESS_DISTRIBUTION_FAILED (and analogously for READ/RESIDUAL); query_recoverable = A4a-recovers OR A2-linearly-decodable

integrity.why_not: the change replaces a mis-operationalization with the spec's own functional definition; it was authorized, it does not alter any threshold, and it does not select among competing outcomes to obtain a desired verdict. NOT_LOCALIZED remains reachable and is unit-tested (test_not_localized_when_neither_linear_nor_functional_recoverable).
integrity.reproduction_unaffected: this is a classifier-only change; the reproduced training runs, snapshots, captured tensors, and reproduction gate are untouched
